title: Edit with the keyboard alone
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- Nothing will glow yellow. You decide where to click.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

Do all of it with keyboard shortcuts. The toolbar buttons work, but they will not count.

playgroundTask.goal: You edited a note using only the keyboard
playgroundTask.hint: Every shortcut is the Command key (or Control on Windows) held down with one letter. The letter is usually the first letter of the word: Bold, Copy, Paste.

steps.say: Write a short note — anything you like.

drDigitalSuccess: You edited a document without touching the mouse once. Those same shortcuts work in email, in a browser, and in every writing app you will ever use.
drDigitalHint: Hold Command (or Control) and press a letter. A for All, B for Bold, C for Copy, V for paste, Z for undo.
